name: Agent Basics
description: Built-in tools a user can give their own agent (quox agent create): save a memory in its own org, post into the slot an admin bound it to, read a URL an org admin allowlisted, and (operator org only) read the proof board. quox#1171.

tools.name: Save Memory
tools.description: Save a fact, decision or preference for later recall, in the agent's own org only.

type.description: fact, preference, decision, constraint or note

tools.name: Post To Bound Slot
tools.description: Post a message into the slot an org admin bound this agent to (quox agent bind-slot). Any other slot is refused.

tools.name: Fetch Allowlisted URL
tools.description: HTTP GET a URL under a prefix an org admin allowlisted (quox fetch allow add). Redirects refused, loopback and metadata addresses refused, body capped at 256 KB and returned as untrusted text; every attempt leaves a receipt.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL inside an allowlisted prefix

tools.name: Proof Board Status
tools.description: Read the instance operator's proof board: strict headline pass/of, release-proven jobs, freshness, regressions, per-domain counts. Operator-only: it can be given only to an agent in the operator's org, or by an instance admin.

domain.description: One proof domain to list its cases
